text: True or False: With best current practice, honestly benchmarked photonic accelerators project to about 1000x better energy per delivered MAC than contemporary GPUs on favorable workloads.
explanation: False — the honest projection is several-fold, approaching an order of magnitude, better energy per delivered MAC (roughly 13-25 TOPS/W versus about 1.6-2.8 TOPS/W for A100/H100). The 1000x figure is the pitfall of comparing an optical core against a full electronic system, not system against system.
